notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.content:
[u][b]Menu[/b][/u]

- Added enzyclopedia. It isn't fully fleshed out yet. 
- Added autosave (happens only at one point to make it easier to continue after updates in the future)

[u][b]Grafik[/b][/u]

- A few graphical adjustments.

The new graphic will be implemented step by step from now on.
You should start a new game!

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.content:
[u][b]Control[/b][/u]

- Added the possibility to use WASD.
- It is now possible to move diagonally. 

[u][b]System[/b][/u]

- Added the possibility to choose a difficulty at the beginning of the game. There are 5 differents options to choose from. The changes are explained in the selection screen(see below).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924719/158de64e9c88f144b6b43bfaa53f1f4e703fbb8e.png[/img]

- Added a camp. This camp is accessible through the menu. It should be only accessible in the overworld but there may be some exceptions where it is also accessible on other locations. This will be fixed later. 
- Added a storage system to the camp. You can store your items if you don't need them anymore and want to keep your inventory cleaned up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924719/37487fc81baee2d68d61fc951087f79f5cc2d554.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924719/6eda83e4d85ee14320301aa3887e797da0bff5f7.png[/img]

- Added the version number in the title screen.

[u][b]Battles[/b][/u]

- Changed the enemies a bit and adjusted the size to align it with the size of the player (see below).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924719/f0d152b4c9f1e5356c08f6a6badcb72f4a716fdf.png[/img]

[u][b]Bugsl[/b][/u]

- Fixed a bug where the game crashed during the dialogue when you left the "Brunnendungeon" after retrieving the "Königsschwert".

Because of some changes regarding the way the story will be told going forward, there are no new story segments right now. 
I'm currently working on a new mechanic that will hopefully make the game even more unique.
I hope that I will be able to share some more informations anytime soon. Stay tuned! 

Saves that were created with the last version should be compatible with this version too. BUT the game will probably automatically choose the lowest difficulty which means that you will continue your saves on the lowest difficulty. You have to start a new game if you want to choose a difficulty.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.3
notes.content: Fixed a bug that prevented the player from continuing after he left the "Brunnendungeon".

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.2
notes.content:
- Fixed some teleports that were wrong.
- Changed some sound volumes.
- Replaced some of the wrong character faces/sprites.
- Objects you could pass, but shouldn't be able to, were fixed.
- Some minor changes to events to create a better game flow.

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
This is the first update after the release of the shop page! I will release update very frewuently from now on.
The first step is done and I'm very excited about the next few weeks and months until "Astria" will be officially released!

[b]Saves that were created before this update are not incompatible with this version! If you continue older saves, the game will crash eventually, mainly in battles![/b]

Finally the moment to publish my first ever patchnotes has come! I hope you are as excited as I am!


[u][b]Environment[/b][/u]
- Added a day/night-cycle.
- Added a weather-cycle.

[u][b]Characters[/b][/u]
- Added new character sprites.
 -> It is possible that the old sprites/faces show in some dialogues/events. Please inform the developer if you see false sprites/faces!
- Character names are now above the message box in dialogues. 
 -> It is possible that some names are still in the normal dialogue box and not in a different box. Please inform the developer if you see misplaced character names!
- The main character is now a fixed member of the party and cannot be replaced or removed! 

[u][b]Battles[/b][/u]
- Added sideview battles.
- Added new battlelayout.
-  Added hp bars for enemies.
- Added numbers/icons to show how much damage the enemy has taken or which effects applied to it.
- Added a screen after the battle that shows exp gain, item/gold drops and quotes of characters.
- Added a new mechanic with which you are able to analyse enemies and after that you are able to press "SHIFT" to see informations about said enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924719/0ae39277e2e41b50223f57373f1458c897f7cc84.png[/img]

[u][b]Menus[/b][/u]
- Added a new save menu.
 -> Shows number of total save files.
 -> Shows your current amount of gold.
 -> Shows your location.
 -> Shows your current chapter.
 -> Shows your party members.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924719/a0c4043e53c44da01e38d506c19e800ef2d7c880.png[/img]

- Added new "Options" menu in the title screen and ingame menu screen.
 -> Options to adjust colours.
 -> Options to adjust sounds.
 -> Option to activate/deactivate battle animations.
 -> Option to activate/deactivate auto-run.
 -> Option to show messages instantly or slowly during dialogues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924719/9c133feee8e2eb9d0e86a3e14396dfd77348370e.png[/img]

- Changed the formations menu.

- Changed the shop menu.

[u][b]Story[/b][/u]

- Added a prologue.

[u][b]Other changes[/b][/u]

- Added chapters.
- Added quest log.
- Overhauled some of the early maps, e.g.: "Soldatenlager", "Schloss, 1. Etage", "Schloss, 2. Etage", "Brunnen", "Unterschlupf", "Geheimausgang".
- Several bug fixes.



This was everything for today! It is rather a "technical" update. Next weeks update will have more story content.
Thank you so much that you have read this far. Please inform me of any bugs you encounter!
I wish you a very fun time playing this update!
